The '''Gauntlet gang area''' was the name given to an area on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that was taken over by the [[Gauntlet (gang)|Gauntlet]] street gang. [[Club Imperato]] was located in the area, and the region was accessible by a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] from the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]].
